tier2.summary:
INCOMPLETE
  ✗ README/docs read-only section lists the blocked endpoints explicitly (submit, export, import, /ws/chat) and carries the same discover-exemption sentence as integration.md:328; grep of both docs agrees with readOnlyAllowedPost; verified live on a scratch --readonly instance that submit/export/import return 403 while POST /api/v1/problems/discover returns 200: The docs half is satisfied but the README half is not. PASS evidence: docs/api-reference.md:642-654 now lists the blocked endpoints explicitly ('POST /api/v1/problems/submit', 'POST /api/v1/export', 'POST /api/v1/import' -> 403) plus '/ws/chat' disabled, and carries the discover-exemption sentence at api-reference.md:652 ('POST /api/v1/problems/discover is deliberately exempt: discovery is a pure read (cached-answer lookup that mutates nothing) ... the same rule readOnlyAllowedPost implements in internal/api/server.go'), matching docs/integration.md:328. grep agreement confirmed: readOnlyAllowedPost (internal/api/server.go:129) returns path == "/api/v1/problems/discover" as the sole exemption, the guard at server.go:112 blocks every other POST /api/v1/*, and /ws/chat is blocked at server.go:107 — both docs match exactly. Live verification independently reproduced on a scratch --readonly instance (binary built from HEAD via `go build -o /tmp/ob1-eval ./cmd/off-by-one`, exit 0; OFF_BY_ONE_DB=/tmp/ob1-eval.db OFF_BY_ONE_PORT=8899 --readonly): POST /api/v1/problems/submit -> 403 {"error":"read_only","message":"catalog is read-only — submissions go through the upstream lab"}; POST /api/v1/export -> 403 read_only; POST /api/v1/import -> 403 read_only; GET /ws/chat -> 403 'AI agent disabled in read-only catalog mode'; POST /api/v1/problems/discover {"problem_class":"so-nil-pointer-deref"} -> HTTP 200 {"found":true,...}; GET /api/v1/stats -> readonly:true. FAIL evidence: README.md has NO read-only section at all. `grep -n -i 'readonly|read-only|read only|403' README.md` returns only lines 146 (required_tools), 204 (OFF_BY_ONE_READONLY env-table row), 226 (--readonly flag-table row), and 405 (ob1.it.com blurb). README.md:204 and README.md:226 say only 'block all mutating endpoints and the AI chat' — no explicit endpoint list (submit/export/import), no /ws/chat mention, no 403, and no discover-exemption sentence. Commit 415cc18 ('board+docs: ... fix readonly docs') touched ONLY docs/api-reference.md (10 lines, +8/-1); `git show 415cc18 --stat` lists no README.md. The criterion is a single conjunctive sentence that explicitly names README as an alternative location ('README/docs read-only section'), so the README half being absent leaves the criterion unmet as written.
docs/api-reference.md and docs/integration.md now list the blocked endpoints and the discover-exemption sentence in exact agreement with readOnlyAllowedPost, and live scratch --readonly verification confirms submit/export/import -> 403 while POST /api/v1/problems/discover -> 200, but README.md carries no read-only section listing the blocked endpoints or the discover-exemption sentence, so the conjunctive criterion is not fully met.
